subtitle.id: Punya kritik, ide, atau sekadar ingin menyapa? Tulis di sini. Nama boleh dikosongkan kalau kamu ingin mengirim tanpa identitas.
subtitle.en: Have a critique, an idea, or just want to say hello? Write it here. Leave the name blank if you would rather stay anonymous.

success.id: Terima kasih. Masukan kamu sudah masuk dan akan saya baca.
success.en: Thank you. Your feedback has been received and I will read it.

privacy.id: Masukan ini hanya dibaca oleh saya. Nama dan kontak boleh dikosongkan.
privacy.en: This feedback is read only by me. Name and contact are optional.
